links.covers: Anemia: MCV classes, reticulocyte count, RBC indices
Lead poisoning: lead level, iron studies
Pyloric stenosis: hypokalemic hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis
Neonatal hepatitis: cholestasis (dx of exclusion; liver bx)
Strep pharyngitis: rapid antigen test, culture
Pyloric stenosis: abdominal US, upper GI string sign
Intussusception: US target sign, air/contrast enema
Duodenal atresia: double bubble, upper GI
Retropharyngeal abscess: lateral neck X-ray, CT
DDH: US under 4 months, AP X-ray after
Tetralogy of Fallot: echo, boot-shaped heart
Osgood-Schlatter: tibial tuberosity, patellar tendon insertion
SCFE: slip through the growth plate
Legg-Calvé-Perthes: ischemia of the capital femoral epiphysis
Acute otitis media: eustachian tube blockage
Febrile UTI: AAP renal/bladder US at 2 to 24 months
Safe sleep: back to sleep (6 months)
Obesity: BMI yearly, USPSTF screening from age 6

workup.title: Abdominal pain
workup.conds: Appendicitis, Intussusception, Volvulus, Functional constipation, Acute gastroenteritis, Inflammatory bowel disease

workup.title: Altered mental status
workup.conds: Meningitis, Diabetic ketoacidosis, Ingestion of harmful substances, Traumatic brain injury, Hypoglycemia

workup.title: Bruising and bleeding
workup.conds: Coagulation disorders, Immune thrombocytopenic purpura, Leukemias, Child abuse and neglect (her guide: Bleeding Disorders note)

workup.title: Constipation
workup.conds: Functional constipation, Hirschsprung disease, Fecal impaction/encopresis

workup.title: Cough
workup.conds: Asthma, Acute bronchiolitis, Pneumonias, Pertussis, Cystic fibrosis, Foreign body aspiration

workup.title: Dehydration
workup.conds: Acute gastroenteritis, Pyloric stenosis, Diabetic ketoacidosis (her guide: Dehydration note)

workup.title: Diarrhea
workup.conds: Acute gastroenteritis, Foodborne illness, Celiac disease, Inflammatory bowel disease

workup.title: Ear pain
workup.conds: Otitis media, Otitis externa, Mastoiditis, Foreign body

workup.title: Failure to thrive
workup.conds: Failure to thrive, Cystic fibrosis, Celiac disease, Congenital heart disease

workup.title: Fever and rash
workup.conds: Viral exanthems (Measles, Rubella, Roseola, Erythema infectiosum, Varicella, Hand, foot, and mouth disease), Kawasaki disease, Scarlet fever (her guide: exanthem rows)

workup.title: Fever in the infant
workup.conds: Fever in the infant, Sepsis, Meningitis, Cystitis

workup.title: Headache
workup.conds: Headache (migraine, tension, idiopathic intracranial hypertension), Meningitis, Neoplasms of the central nervous system

workup.title: Hearing loss
workup.conds: Hearing disorders, Otitis media, Cerumen impaction (her guide: Hearing Impairment note)

workup.title: Heart murmur
workup.conds: Congenital heart disease, Valvular disorders

workup.title: Jaundice in the newborn
workup.conds: Neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, Biliary/Duodenal atresia, Hepatitis

workup.title: Limp
workup.conds: Developmental dysplasia of the hip, Slipped capital femoral epiphysis, Avascular necrosis, Juvenile idiopathic arthritis, Fractures/Dislocations

workup.title: Pallor and fatigue
workup.conds: Anemias, Lead poisoning, Leukemias

workup.title: Red eye
workup.conds: Conjunctivitis, Orbital/Periorbital cellulitis

workup.title: Scrotal pain or swelling
workup.conds: Testicular torsion, Hydrocele, Orchitis, Testicular mass

workup.title: Seizure
workup.conds: Febrile seizure, Seizure disorders, Meningitis

workup.title: Short stature
workup.conds: Growth hormone deficiency, Turner syndrome, Physical growth parameters (her guide: Short Stature row)

workup.title: Sore throat
workup.conds: Pharyngitis, Peritonsillar abscess/Retropharyngeal abscess, Epiglottitis, Epstein-Barr virus

workup.title: Stridor
workup.conds: Laryngotracheobronchitis (croup), Epiglottitis, Foreign body aspiration

workup.title: Syncope
workup.conds: Syncope, neurogenic (her guide: Syncope row)

workup.title: Vomiting
workup.conds: Pyloric stenosis, Acute gastroenteritis, Intussusception, Volvulus, Gastroesophageal reflux disease

workup.title: Wheezing
workup.conds: Asthma, Acute bronchiolitis, Foreign body aspiration
